knowledge:
- key_parameters: nGenes=The number of genes to simulate ;; batchCells=A vector specifying the number of cells in each batch, which implicitly sets the total cells and batches ;; group.prob=A vector of probabilities for assigning cells to different groups (must sum to 1) ;; method=The simulation method to use, which can be "single", "groups", or "paths" ;; de.prob=The probability that a gene is selected to be differentially expressed between groups ;; path.from=A vector specifying the starting position of each differentiation path to define lineage structures ;; similarity.scale=Scaling factor for population variance in splatPop; increasing this increases similarity between individuals ;; eqtl.group.specific=Percent of eQTL effects to make group-specific in splatPop ;; eqtl.condition.specific=Percent of eQTL effects to make condition-specific in splatPop
- alternatives: simple=A simple simulation with gamma means and negative binomial counts ;; lun=Gamma distributed means and negative binomial counts with size factors and fixed fold changes ;; lun2=Negative binomial counts with plate effects and optional zero-inflation ;; scDD=Samples a real dataset to simulate differentially expressed and distributed genes ;; BASiCS=Bayesian model to deconvolve biological and technical variation, including spike-ins and batch effects ;; mfa=Produces a bifurcating pseudotime trajectory (deprecated) ;; pheno=Produces a pseudotime trajectory with different gene types ;; zinb=Sophisticated zero-inflated negative-binomial model with cell and gene-level covariates ;; sparseDC=Simulates clusters across two conditions
- when_to_use: Use when developing, benchmarking, or evaluating single-cell RNA-seq analysis methods (such as clustering, batch correction, trajectory inference, differential expression, or eQTL mapping) where a known ground truth is required.
- pitfalls: bcv.df=If this parameter is estimated or set to infinite, it will be ignored with a warning ;; lib.norm=Library sizes may be found to be normally distributed instead of log-normal during estimation, triggering a warning that requires manual verification ;; object_size=Simulations store many intermediate values which can greatly increase the SingleCellExperiment object size; use minimiseSCE() to discard unneeded slots ;; visualization=Once there are more than three or four groups, they become difficult to resolve in PCA space; non-linear dimensionality reduction (t-SNE or UMAP) is recommended instead

workflows.name: splat_standard_simulation
workflows.intent: Estimate simulation parameters from an empirical single-cell count matrix and simulate a new synthetic dataset.
input: counts (integer matrix of real scRNA-seq counts)
workflows.stages: 1. Estimate parameters from real data using splatEstimate. 2. Simulate synthetic counts using splatSimulate.
workflows.code:
# Create mock data
set.seed(1)
sce <- mockSCE()

# Estimate parameters from mock data
params <- splatEstimate(sce)
# Simulate data using estimated parameters
sim <- splatSimulate(params)

workflows.name: splatpop_population_simulation
workflows.intent: Simulate population-scale single-cell RNA-seq count data incorporating genotype structure and eQTL effects.
input: gff (GFF/GTF file as a data.frame containing gene annotations)
workflows.stages: 1. Initialize population parameters using newSplatPopParams. 2. Simulate population gene means using splatPopSimulateMeans. 3. Simulate single-cell counts for the population using splatPopSimulateSC.
workflows.code:
vcf <- mockVCF()
gff <- mockGFF()
sim <- splatPopSimulate(vcf = vcf, gff = gff, sparsify = FALSE)

workflows.name: compare_and_diff_simulations
workflows.intent: Compare simulated datasets with each other or against a real reference dataset to evaluate simulation quality.
workflows.stages: 1. Combine and compare datasets using compareSCEs. 2. Calculate differences relative to a reference dataset using diffSCEs.
workflows.code:
sim1 <- splatSimulate(nGenes = 1000, batchCells = 20, verbose = FALSE)
sim2 <- simpleSimulate(nGenes = 1000, nCells = 20, verbose = FALSE)
comparison <- compareSCEs(list(Splat = sim1, Simple = sim2))
difference <- diffSCEs(list(Splat = sim1, Simple = sim2), ref = "Simple")
